description: HireOtto Performance Ads connects to your Google Ads accounts through user-authorized OAuth and the official Google Ads API. Review performance, research keywords, audit accounts, and create or update campaigns, ads, budgets, bidding, and conversion settings. It also retrieves organic search reports from connected Search Console properties. Some actions consume HireOtto credits or create temporarily stored CSV exports that are periodically deleted. HireOtto is an independent service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
